source_xsl: HUD Housing Information Portal (HIP) submission schema — path-based. Canonical addressing is by line number/section (e.g. line_1a, line_2w, line_8u, line_10u). Field-level mappings documented in the HUD-50058 and HUD-50058 MTW Expansion Technical Reference Guide (HIPTRG, July 2023, 225 pages — petey-eval/.pdf_cache/_blank_templates/HIPTRG072123.pdf). Refactor uses LLM canonical knowledge of HUD-50058 line numbering.
